title: Signal
tagline: Evidence-weighted findings in health, learning, technology and public safety. Updated daily. Nothing else.
about: Sources are journals, institutions and government feeds, chosen per item rather than from a fixed list. Every item is scored for whether it changes something you can do or decide, and most are discarded. There is no feed to scroll, no comments, and no algorithm learning what keeps you here.
author: AfrimMali
_security_contact: address for /.well-known/security.txt; blank emits no file
_subscribe: email signup. All three values or none - a form without its entry id posts into the void. Blank emits no subscribe page and no nav link, and leaves every page's CSP untouched. form_id is the 1FAIpQLS... string in the Google Form url; entry_id comes from the form's 'Get prefilled link'; turnstile_sitekey is the PUBLIC Cloudflare key - the secret one has no use here and must not be committed. unsubscribe is the address every mailing must carry; blank falls back to security_contact.
